About Me

Security mindset. Operations discipline.

I'm a self-motivated learner with a strong foundation in IT operations, Linux, networking, and cybersecurity. My academic and practical work has given me hands-on experience with AWS EC2, S3, and IAM, Docker, Git, Jenkins, Apache Airflow, MLflow, and FastAPI.

I enjoy the full lifecycle of a system: understanding how it's built, watching how it behaves through monitoring and log analysis, and improving it through automation. I bring analytical thinking, problem solving, and a strong attention to detail to every task.

I'm currently looking for an IT Operations & DevOps internship where I can contribute and keep growing in production environments.
